properties.name: order-assistant
properties.purpose: A customer-support assistant built on the agent loop (RFC-0011): an llm.run node reasons with a fixed tool catalog certified on this graph. Two tools read the order and its shipment; the one write, a refund, waits for a supervisor through suspend and resume. The graph, not the model, decides where each outcome goes, and the engine stays LLM-free: llm.chat runs on the LLM helper of a language pack behind Event-over-HTTP
The knowledge layer: the tool catalog the loop is allowed to use, and the error handler

The agent's tool catalog, a dataset node under the island: each row maps an API-safe name to a composable route, with the description the model reads and the input schema the loop validates. issue_refund is marked write: true, so it waits for approval
Restore the suspended run of this correlation id, if any: a resumed run continues past the advise checkpoint into decide. A fresh run flows through to check-input
A fresh run needs the customer's question before any token is spent

mapping: text(Missing question. Provide the customer's question in the 'question' field) -> output.body.message
properties.purpose: Reject a request without a question

input: text(You are the customer-support assistant of an online store. Use the tools to check the facts before you answer. Look the order up first, then its shipment. Propose a refund with the issue_refund tool only when the shipment is lost, for the order's total, and give the reason. Answer the customer in two or three plain sentences, and never invent an order, a shipment or a refund.) -> system
properties.purpose: The agent loop: each model turn goes to llm.chat on the LLM helper, each tool call to the route the catalog names, until the model answers, a write waits for a person, or a limit stops it. The first run supplies the prompt; a resumed run supplies the conversation, the turn, the approval block kept in the model and the supervisor's decisions, and the loop carries on
The graph decides on the loop's status: an answer, a call that waits for a person, or a stop
The model's answer to the customer, with the call log and the usage

mapping: text(The model stopped without an answer. The status says why) -> output.body.message
properties.purpose: A refusal or a cap: the run ends and the caller learns why

mapping: text(A tool call waits for a supervisor's decision. Decide each waiting call, then POST again with the same X-Correlation-Id and a body holding turn, this reply's turn number, and decisions, one per waiting call with its id, approved as true or false, and an optional note.) -> output.body.message
properties.purpose: The checkpoint: stage the approval advice - the waiting calls with their arguments, and the calls already answered - then pause. A resumed run continues at decide, never here, unless decide sends it back to advise again
Persist the run under graph:order-assistant:{cid}: the model holds the conversation, the turn and the waiting calls

A resumed run lands here. A request without decisions, or for another turn than the one that waits, re-advises and pauses again. A request with the decisions for this turn resets the loop node and runs it again: the loop takes the waiting calls from the restored model, never from the request, so the call that runs is the call the supervisor saw
The loop's own failure: a bad catalog, llm.chat unreachable or failing, or a resume whose decisions the loop refused. It reports the error and notes whether an approval was pending

A failure while an approval was pending, such as a resume with a decision for an unknown call, must not lose the transaction: the run goes back to the advise checkpoint, which shows the waiting calls again with the error, and pauses. Any other failure ends the run with the error
